news_items.summary: [139.0K stars · Python] The agent engineering platform. Topics: agents, ai, ai-agents, anthropic, chatgpt
news_items.explainer: LangChain is an open-source framework for building applications powered by LLMs, especially agents that can call tools, query data, and chain multiple model calls together. It matters because it is one of the most widely used building blocks in the LLM ecosystem, and the project has expanded into a broader agent engineering platform alongside LangGraph and LangSmith.
